title: Proteomics of Cervical Mineralized Diaphragm in Molar Root–Incisor Malformation
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Molar root–incisor malformation (MRIM) is characterized by abnormalities in the root and pulpal floor, which may lead to dental complications. However, research on MRIM remains limited and is largely confined to case-based observations. Therefore, this ...
